verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card for AI vendor spend, and a buyer could fairly ask whether a fintech service lets them keep their transaction and account data out of AI model training, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions training-data use, opt-outs or any data-usage policy; the docs cover only rewards, partner perks, card requests and redemption.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
